name: Flashlight
note: Lantern: Flashlight: Paint the red barrel as satin red with one broad soft highlight along the top, in place of the hard white streaks. Make the head ring a plain smooth silver band. Keep the flashlight, the ribbed grip, the yellow beam and the cyan rays.

name: Magnifier
note: Hoop Shot: Magnifier: Make the lens glass clear pale blue-white instead of green. Replace the white dot on the glass with a soft curved reflection along the upper-left edge. Keep the silver ring, the red handle and the green ring backdrop.

name: Badge Wallet
note: Travel Book: Wallet: Replace the dark wood planks with bright, warm orange wood with a few broad, soft grain bands. Paint the wallet as smooth soft-brown leather with no stitching or grain, and the badge as one plain gold shape with a soft sheen. Keep the wallet, the green card and the top-down view.

name: Evidence Bag
note: Evidence Bag: Replace the dark mahogany planks with bright, warm honey-orange wood with a few broad, soft grain bands. Give the bag a soft, slightly darker shadow on the wood toward the lower right. Keep the bag, the blue zip and the gold ring.
